description: This file defines the AddComponent class implementing a Drupal plugin for adding components to layout sections within the Drupal layout builder module. It includes methods for creating instances, applying configuration changes, and inserting components into layout sections.

classes.name: Drupal\layout_builder\Plugin\ConfigAction\AddComponent
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that adds a component to a layout builder section, implementing ConfigActionPluginInterface and ContainerFactoryPluginInterface.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin, retrieving dependencies from the container.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the add component action to a given configuration entity, handling multiple values if specified.

methods.name: applySingle
methods.description: Adds a single component to a specified layout section, determining the region and inserting the component.
